faqs.a:
A utility customer may receive an extension of the date on which payment for water
               or sewer services, or both, would otherwise be due to the city, or a credit of up
               to $100.00 to be applied to the customer's utility account with the city, or both.
               The city manager or his designee is hereby authorized to promulgate administrative
               rules or regulations, or both, governing the procedures which shall be followed to
               implement this section.
(Code 1981, § 33-14; Ord. No. 3070, § 1, 4-4-1994)
